_comment: Composite indexes required by the geo-scoped marketplace.
Deliberately short. The query strategy in lib/Services/Marketplace/listing_service.dart
pushes exactly ONE equality predicate to Firestore — the geo tier, which is the most
selective and the one that actually bounds document count. Side, intent, category,
badge, search text and ordering are all applied client-side over that bounded result.
Without that rule the filter space (4 geo tiers x 2 sides x 2 intents x 10 categories)
would need an unmaintainable number of composite indexes. The Heritage service already
The indexes below cover the two cases where geo is combined with status + ordering,
should those be promoted to server-side. Everything else runs index-free on Firestore's
